theorems.name: Submission.rc_diagonal_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type u) [Countable ι] (a : ℕ → ι → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k, |a k i| ≤ C) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ i, ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => a (φ k) i) atTop (𝓝 l)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
